title: Join Tensor error bounds through compression and final restoration
body:
This conditional enabling proof joins expansion, normalized chirp, compression and final restoration into one Tensor error budget. It makes the 3D-bit compression attenuation explicit and gives a smaller sufficient final error comparison. The complete κ calculation and selected frontier are unchanged.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bea42af24ee9850949a4b48d329a7dc85de72b11/research/tensor-restored-error-join/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bea42af24ee9850949a4b48d329a7dc85de72b11/research/tensor-restored-error-join/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bea42af24ee9850949a4b48d329a7dc85de72b11/research/tensor-restored-error-join/SOURCES.json), and [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bea42af24ee9850949a4b48d329a7dc85de72b11/research/tensor-restored-error-join/verify.py). Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

```text
B(D,A) = 8^-D [a(1-beta^D)/(1-beta)+4 sqrt(2) 2^A+22]
         +(16/7)(1-8^-D)
a=sqrt(2)+2^-11; beta=21/38; D>=1; A>=0
restored error < 2^(gamma-p) B(D,A)
p >= gamma+max(A-3D,0)+12 implies restored error < 1/256.
```

All source premises remain: p>=101, p-A>=13, geometry, a common p grid, local work-precision guards, exact factor/coordinate identities, and valid coefficient and primitive contracts. The result replaces only the sufficient final error comparison. It does not install a production policy.

Use CPython 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/tensor-restored-error-join
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/tensor-restored-error-join
```

Both registered modes passed under Python 3.12.13, with warnings as errors and with `-O`. Expected verifier marker: `PASS_JOINED_TENSOR_ERROR_GUARD`. The checks authenticate main-branch composition sources, inspect five schedule sites and both restored components, and verify 3,104 exact rational recurrence cases. The written inequalities prove the all-dimension bound; the cases do not replace that proof. The committed-byte check, export inventory check and both direct exported replay modes passed. `git diff --check` passed. Full-history validation was not run in the shallow checkout. No full physical caller, Lean, native/compiler or selected replay ran.

No production geometry, coefficient backend or complete physical Tensor was re-admitted. CRT entrance/product/return and both S factors remain separate obligations.

This packages [the completed Discussion result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3664#discussioncomment-19150284) as the same contribution with a committed proof and replay. @kumagi’s [PR #5295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5295) supplies the expansion theorem at [commit 351975ee703ec5aa1b18f70f73700d434026199a](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/351975ee703ec5aa1b18f70f73700d434026199a/research/tensor-expansion-accuracy/PROOF.md). This is an explicit external theorem premise, not an executed local input. @JoyboyBrian’s [PR #5081](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5081) supplies the compression refinement. @jmbarrancoml’s retained physical Tensor and chirp sources are linked in the proof and pinned at the base in SOURCES.json. @mdumitrean and the retained native, ownership, precision and compiler authors keep their source credit. New proof and checks: Ali Romman (@aliromman) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. This is author-checked evidence; independent acceptance is not claimed.
